runtime.compileAt: validated activation or a new valid editor preview snapshot
runtime.cacheIdentity: object identity/runtime epoch or content signature; never packageId/revision alone
runtime.cachePolicy: bounded on-demand results; invalidate from data/context/resource/config dependencies; release unused world caches

ruleModel.zoom: required inclusive integer min/max in logical 0..8
ruleModel.match: zoom AND fields; absent fields means true
ruleModel.selection: last matching complete rule in authored list

copy.defaultScope: current classification and same geometry, including inherited rules
copy.crossClassification: same geometry with explicit reference compatibility validation

migration.onNonEquivalentConversion: keep original active native r6 package and produce isolated migration diagnostics; never silently drop behavior
